title: acrorumohra diffracta
intro: Acrorumohra diffracta, commonly known as Indian spikenard or Valeriana wallichii, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anxiolytic, sedative, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Acrorumohra diffracta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include valerenic acid, valepotriates, and sesquiterpenoids, among others. These bioactive compounds contribute to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief, anxiety, and other health conditions.
